events.title: Demo Update v0.2.2: Light the Night
events.summary: Demo Update v0.2.2 is live for Shadows of Beginnings. Night travel has a new source of light, every new game begins beneath a clear sky, and the Mage steps into her new body. This update also adds Steam Input prompts and AMD FSR. LIGHT AT NIGHTA torch now lights the area around you at night and goes out at dawn.
